research_question: Does adding HapRepair's rule-conditioned repair knowledge to the same coding agent improve OpenHarmony alert repair under a common deterministic localization and validation protocol?
null_hypothesis: The agent-integrated HapRepair condition does not improve effectiveness, introduced-alert control, validation reliability, difficult-rule coverage, or efficiency over the vanilla coding-agent condition.
alternative_hypothesis: The agent-integrated HapRepair condition improves at least one preregistered effectiveness, reliability, difficult-rule, or efficiency outcome without an undisclosed protocol difference.
research_objective: Measure the incremental value of HapRepair's frozen rule-conditioned retrieval capability when localization, model, project inputs, evaluator gates, and scan budget are held constant.

common_contract.candidate_retention: Retain candidates after structural, public-API, configured build, or configured test failure; return detailed failure evidence and continue repair in place.
common_contract.last_valid_restoration: If the interaction ends with an invalid candidate, archive it and restore the latest candidate that passed every available gate before the evaluator-only final scan.
common_contract.condition_symmetry: The vanilla and HapRepair-skill conditions use identical candidate-retention, validation-budget, and final-abandonment behavior.

condition_difference.vanilla: No HapRepair repository, skill, corpus, retrieval output, reference repair, or other-condition artifact is mounted or exposed.
condition_difference.hapskill: A restricted Unix-socket broker exposes inspect-rule and frozen Top-1 same-rule Stella retrieval; the corpus and HapRepair repository remain outside the agent-visible filesystem.

dataset.formal_input_rule: Formal execution requires a freshly frozen target-finding manifest for each pinned source tree.

formal_run.superseded_reason: formal_02 used immediate per-round rollback and was stopped during method development when the candidate-retention policy was adopted; all outputs are retained and excluded from analysis

excluded_formal_runs.reason: Evaluator wrapper infrastructure failure before Hvigor; retained as non-pooled incident evidence.
Interrupted method-development run under the superseded immediate-rollback policy; retained and excluded from analysis.

pilot.superseded_reason: The first paired attempt stopped before the C1 model call because its Unix-domain socket path exceeded the platform length limit; no result is pooled.

stop_condition: Stop early only when no target findings remain and the current candidate is accepted; otherwise stop after five post-edit validation attempts. If the final candidate still requires repair, archive it and restore last-valid before the final scan.
abandonment_condition: Stop and preserve the run on input mismatch, protocol/hash drift, model/provider drift, broker failure, scanner failure, or agent access to a restricted artifact.
claim_boundary: HomeCheck alert elimination is not semantic correctness; real-project results apply only to detected defects.
